_comment: Ambiguous overlay-address citations resolved to an IMAGE per citing row, via the game's own progression table (0x80077FA0) and the disc scene->blob law. Rows whose stage scope spans several overlays get NO answer and are listed with the reason. Regenerate: tools/phase4_overlay_row_image_resolver.py

method.axis: row stage -> scene (progression table, read from SCUS_942.88) -> blob
method.scene_to_blob_law: dir = scene if scene<=10 else scene-10; file = LEVEL.BIN if scene<=10 else LEVEL1.BIN

known_positive_gate.independent_basis: writer-set constraint: both stores exist in exactly 1 of 20 images (analysis/phase4_f00_state_owner_probe.json)
disc-side pin: the overlay address belonged to LEVEL03, not LEVEL02
